sloka: विघूर्णमानो निश्चेष्टो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।विसञ्ज्ञो मूर्च्छितश्चासीन्न च स्थानं समालभत् ।। ६.५९.११७ ।।।।
transliteration: vighūrṇamāno niśceṣṭo rathopastha upāviśat ।visañjño mūrcchitaścāsīnna ca sthānaṁ samālabhat ।। 6.59.117 ।।।।

translations.english: Much blood flowed from his(Ravana's) mouth, ears, and eyes. Rolling in the hind part of the chariot he became still and sank.
